xhs.title: 没有垃圾回收，Rust 内存谁来管？
xhs.body:
第 6 课：所有权的三条规则
① 每个值都有一个主人
② 同一时刻只有一个主人
③ 主人离开作用域，值自动清理
考考你：let s2 = s1; 之后再打印 s1，能编译吗？（s1 是 String） 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: No garbage collector, no manual free. Rust manages memory with 3 ownership rules. Quick quiz: let s2 = s1; then print s1 (a String). Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Rust has no garbage collector. Here's who frees the memory.
linkedin.body:
Rule 1: every value has an owner.
Rule 2: there is only one owner at a time. Assign it away, and the old name can't be used.
Rule 3: when the owner goes out of scope, the value is dropped.
All checked at compile time, so there's no runtime cost.
Quick quiz: let s2 = s1; then print s1 (a String). Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: let s2 = s1; 之后再打印 s1，能编译吗？（s1 是 String）
quiz.q_en: let s2 = s1; then print s1 (a String). Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。let s2 = s1 把所有权交给了 s2（同一时刻只有一个主人），s1 不能再用（borrow of moved value）。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. let s2 = s1 moves ownership to s2 (one owner at a time), so s1 can no longer be used (borrow of moved value).
